newsitem.title: UK: Italy prices 3.0 bln mark-into-euro 10-year bond.
newsitem.headline: Italy prices 3.0 bln mark-into-euro 10-year bond.

text.p: The following redenominatable bond, announced earlier Thursday by joint lead managers Deutsche Morgan Grenfell and SBC Warburg, has been priced.
The notes will be redenominated in euros after EMU.
The deal was increased to 3.0 billion marks ($1.7 billion) from 2.0 billion marks between its launch and pricing.
